description: Open Data Parkeren: PARKING TOEGANG is a dataset listed in RDW (Netherlands Vehicle Authority) open data portal (opendata.rdw.nl), an open data portal (Socrata) of a national body, published or maintained by RDW (Netherlands Vehicle Authority). Toegangstijden van een parkeergebied, -garage of -terrein. Als een toegang gesloten is kan de uitgang wel open zijn. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the category Parkeren. Its tags are toegang, parkeren. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2026-07-07 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-rdw-nl-portal.
